photos.observed: Layered face, uneven horizontal incisions, narrow vertical separations, clustered irregular cavities, pale and dark-gray surface regions, plants at crown and local openings.
Large-volume peaks, exposed wall regions surrounded by vegetation, warm illumination and atmospheric depth; not used as intrinsic rock albedo or measured height.
Substantial cliff volume, pale exposed faces with dark vertical markings, angular weathered foreground rocks, soil and vegetation between rock exposures.
